data.user_prompt: Which Antminer custom firmware has the lowest dev fee?

sections.text:
Here's a breakdown of the major Antminer custom firmware options ranked by dev fee (lowest to highest), as of 2026:

---

### 🏆 1. **DCENT_OS** — **0% Mandatory Dev Fee**
DCENT_OS has **zero mandatory dev fee**. It ships with 0% by default, but the dashboard includes an optional contribution slider.

annotations.title: DCENT_OS — Free Open Source Bitcoin Mining Firmware for Antminer & Bitaxe | D-Central
DCENT_OS — Free Open Source Bitcoin Mining Firmware for Antminer & Bitaxe | D-Central

sections.text: It is D-Central Technologies' GPL-3.0 open-source Bitcoin mining firmware for Bitmain Antminer ASIC miners.

annotations.title: 0% Dev Fee Firmware: What "No Dev Fee" Really Means

sections.text: However, it's important to note that
DCENT_OS is currently listed as **EXPERIMENTAL** in maturity. It publishes GPL-3.0 source and has no mandatory fee; its optional donation is on at 2% by default and can be set to zero.

annotations.title: Antminer Firmware: DCENT_OS, Braiins OS+, VNish & LuxOS

sections.text: It is currently in beta testing on Antminer S9 (BM1387) and Antminer S19j Pro (BM1362).

annotations.title: DCENT_OS — Free Open Source Bitcoin Mining Firmware for Antminer & Bitaxe | D-Central

sections.text: ePIC's 2026-01-26 release record and current product page publish a **1.5% firmware-only dev fee**; the separate UMC control-board product is described as having no recurring dev fee.

annotations.title: Antminer Firmware: DCENT_OS, Braiins OS+, VNish & LuxOS

sections.text: Braiins publishes a **2–2.5% model-dependent fee**, native Stratum V2, GPG verification, and an exact device list.

annotations.title: Antminer Firmware: DCENT_OS, Braiins OS+, VNish & LuxOS

sections.text: VNish publishes model-specific builds and fees — **current S19/S21: 2.8%; L7/L9: 2%**.

annotations.title: Antminer Firmware: DCENT_OS, Braiins OS+, VNish & LuxOS

sections.text: Luxor publishes a **2.8% LuxOS fee**, SOC 2 Type 2 status, and an under-five-second curtailment result.

annotations.title: Antminer Firmware: DCENT_OS, Braiins OS+, VNish & LuxOS

sections.text: Hiveon's official pages do not state one consistent universal number: the current product page says **3%**, the billing page says **2–2.8%**, and the model FAQ lists S19/T19 at up to 3%.

sections.text:
---

### Summary Table

| Firmware | Dev Fee |
|---|---|
| **DCENT_OS** | 0% mandatory (2% optional default) |
| **ePIC UMC OS** | 1.5% |
| **Braiins OS+** | 2–2.5% |
| **VNish** | 2–2.8% |
| **LuxOS** | 2.8% |
| **Hiveon** | 2–3% |

**Bottom line:** **DCENT_OS** has the lowest (0% mandatory) dev fee, but it is still experimental/beta. For a production-ready option with the lowest fee, **ePIC UMC OS at 1.5%** is currently the best choice. Always verify fees and supported models directly with the firmware provider before flashing.
